name: Branch Protection
description: Blocks git checkout or switch commands targeting main or master branches
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block checkout/switch to main or master
CMD="$1"
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+(checkout|switch)\s+(main|master)(\s|$)'; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Direct checkout to main/master is not allowed. Use a feature branch."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
